title: Xaurora: Generative Weather Forecasting with Denoising Stochastic Interpolants from a Foundation Model Prior
abstract: arXiv:2610.06509v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning has revolutionised weather forecasting in recent years, especially through atmospheric foundation models, which offer competitive skill for a fraction of the computational costs of classic physics-based models. However, most existing foundation models are deterministic, limiting the generation of large ensembles for accurate uncertainty quantification, extreme weather risk assessment, and long-range weather forecasting. Furthermore, these models incur a large, often prohibitive, computational overhead to train from scratch. To address these shortcomings, we turn a pretrained deterministic prior model, namely the Aurora foundation model, into a generative ensemble-prediction model. To that end, we introduce a novel generative method, Denoising Stochastic Interpolants, combined with a replay buffer for Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) rollout, enabling probabilistic training of SDE trajectories. translated_title: Xaurora：基于基础模型先验的去噪随机插值生成式天气预报
translated_abstract: 近年来，深度学习彻底改变了天气预报领域，尤其是通过大气基础模型，这些模型以经典物理模型计算成本的一小部分提供了具有竞争力的预报能力。然而，大多数现有的基础模型是确定性的，这限制了通过生成大型集合预报来实现准确的不确定性量化、极端天气风险评估和长期天气预报。此外，这些模型从头开始训练需要巨大的、往往令人望而却步的计算开销。为了解决这些缺点，我们将一个预训练的确定性先验模型，即Aurora基础模型，转变为生成式集合预报模型。为此，我们引入了一种新颖的生成方法——去噪随机插值，并结合用于随机微分方程（SDE）滚动的重放缓冲区，实现了SDE轨迹的概率化训练。
tldr: 本文提出Xaurora方法，通过新颖的去噪随机插值生成技术和SDE重放缓冲区，将预训练的确定性大气基础模型Aurora转变为生成式集合预报模型，以低成本实现概率化天气预报与不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: Xaurora transforms the pretrained deterministic Aurora foundation model into a generative ensemble prediction model via a novel Denoising Stochastic Interpolants method with an SDE rollout replay buffer, enabling efficient probabilistic weather forecasting and uncertainty quantification.
